request.source:
-- 只读采集九州贸易决策输入；不调用游戏函数，不修改断点或运行状态。
local context=debug_getCurrentContextTable(false)
assert(type(context)=='table','Stopped context required')
assert(context.RIP==getAddress('victoria3.exe+11FD5C9'),'Unexpected stopped instruction')
assert(context.R14==0x3A484D9DB60,'Unexpected state pointer')
local entry=context.RDI
assert(math.type(entry)=='integer' and entry~=0,'Invalid entry pointer')
-- 读取一个候选；入参为候选地址，返回商品身份与定点字段，不调用有效性函数。
local function candidate(address)
    local goods=readQword(address)
    assert(math.type(goods)=='integer' and goods~=0,'Invalid candidate goods')
    local length=readQword(goods+0x28)
    local capacity=readQword(goods+0x30)
    local name=''
    if capacity==15 and length~=nil and length>=0 and length<=15 then name=readString(goods+0x18,length+1,false) end
    local vtable=readQword(goods)
    local validFunction=vtable and readQword(vtable)
    local score=readQword(address+0x20)
    local quantity=readQword(address+0x38)
    local revenue=readQword(address+0x10)
    local unitRevenue=readQword(address+0x18)
    return {address=string.format('%X',address),goods=string.format('%X',goods),goodsId=readInteger(goods+0x10),
        name=name,direction=readBytes(address+8,1),mode=readInteger(address+0x2C),flags40=readBytes(goods+0x40,1),
        scoreRaw=score,score=score and score/100000,quantityRaw=quantity,quantity=quantity and quantity/100000,
        revenueRaw=revenue,unitRevenueRaw=unitRevenue,
        validityInstruction=validFunction and disassemble(validFunction) or ''}
end
local base=getAddress('victoria3.exe')
local maintain=readQword(base+(0x7FF77C37A928-0x7FF776AF0000))
local replacement=readQword(base+(0x7FF77C37A910-0x7FF776AF0000))
local initMultiplier=readQword(base+(0x7FF77C37A8F0-0x7FF776AF0000))
local globalState=readQword(base+(0x7FF77C3A8A50-0x7FF776AF0000))
local gameState=globalState and readQword(globalState+0x608)
local initializing=gameState and readBytes(gameState+0x148,1)
return {pid=getOpenedProcessID(),rip=string.format('%X',context.RIP),rsp=string.format('%X',context.RSP),
    state=string.format('%X',context.R14),entry=string.format('%X',entry),
    remaining=readInteger(entry+4),capacityLimit=readInteger(context.R14+0x1D58),capacityUsed=readInteger(context.R14+0x1D5C),
    add=candidate(entry+0xB0),remove=candidate(entry+0xF8),initializing=initializing,
    maintainThresholdRaw=maintain,replacementMultiplierRaw=replacement,initializingMultiplierRaw=initMultiplier}
